# Projectile Data Table

Source: [wiki article 2041](../archive/2041.md); edited 2023-12-28.

<a id="wiki-2041-n1"></a>

- Measured projectile catalog was compiled for Improved Nade Tool with linked original spreadsheet; behavioral data explicitly last updated December 27, 2023.

<a id="wiki-2041-n2"></a>

- Columns distinguish gravity g, initial speed v_0, launch-direction upward bias delta, cast time and projectile radius against world geometry; these are different parameters from hero-hitbox projectile radius.

<a id="wiki-2041-n3"></a>

- Delta is the magnitude of an upward vector added to launch direction, not an origin-height offset; article links an interactive geometry demonstration.

<a id="wiki-2041-n4"></a>

- Gravity table includes current-at-the-time and explicitly old/reworked abilities; typical examples include Baptiste launcher/field both g=-20.1,v=60,delta=.007, and Zarya cannon/graviton g=-9.84,v=25,delta=.1.

<a id="wiki-2041-n5"></a>

- Linear-projectile section is explicitly WIP with many blank gravity/speed/delta/cast columns; blanks must remain unknown rather than become zero.

<a id="wiki-2041-n6"></a>

- Rows for old Orisa supercharger/Wrecking Ball minefield contain nonnumeric placeholders ('nope','really?','non-zero') rather than complete physics models.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/2041.md).
